adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, the `minimumTokenResponseSchema` is defined as `z.object({ access_token: z.string(), [z.string().toString()]: z.number(), [z.string().optional().toString()]: z.unknown().optional() })`. Those computed property names evaluate immediately to a single literal string key (e.g., something like "[object Object]") rather than acting as a wildcard/catchall. As a result, Zod will treat fields like `expiry_date`, `expires_in`, `instance_url`, etc. as unknown keys and (with default `z.object` behavior) strip them from the parsed result, matching the finding’s claim of silent dropping of token fields.
